QX60 Exterior
COMMANDING PRESENCE
The first thing you notice about QX60 is its
undeniable presence. With a commanding
stance and katana-inspired lower door finishers
that exude power and sophistication, the sleek
lines and intricate details weave together to
create a luxurious style that stops people in
their tracks. In the elegantly designed QX60,
you’ll speak volumes without saying a word.

capability.

QX60 Exterior
REAR DESIGN CUES
The Digital Piano Key taillights of the QX60
are marked by crisp segments like piano keys.
The horizontal design wraps around and joins
with a central garnish, giving it a wide, stable,
plated appearance. Deep-set LEDs light each
taillight segment, and the reflector illuminates
with a uniform glow rather than pinpoints of
light. Inside, subtle patterns reward a closer look,
like the facets of a gem.

ENERGETIC COMFORT

interior of the QX60 offers a sense of calm the
first time you get in — and this remains true

exquisitely tailored details in a setting of
elegantly crafted simplicity.

We’ve re-envisioned the third row with the
cargo area in mind. The available one-touch
power return5 means putting the seats upright
is practically effortless. When you’re packing
extra stuff, the third row is split 60:40, so you
can easily fold one or both sides. And loading up
is easy: Use the Intelligent Key or swing your
foot under the rear bumper to use the available
Motion-Activated Liftgate. You can even keep
items safe and prevent them from rolling around
with the under-floor storage.2
